texts.zh: 随着义体件在我们的生活中愈发根深蒂固，盈利模式的变化将极大地影响整个社会。近来，植入体制造商将一些基本功能限制在订阅模式中成为了一种潮流。如果忘记付款，义体躯干可能会突然被锁定、视力可能会消失。消费者权益组织正在敦促我们出台措施阻止这种现象。
texts.en: With cyberware being so engrained in our lives, changes in monetization models affect our entire society dramatically. The recent trend has implants manufacturers lock essential functionalities behind a subscription model. Miss a payment and suddenly, your cyberlimbs lock up, and your optics turn off. Consumer organizations are urging us to put a stop to these practices.

label.zh: 买不起就别用，有的时候找找自己的原因。
label.en: If they can't afford it, they shouldn't buy it.

label.zh: 将订阅限制在非关键功能上。
label.en: Limit the subscriptions to non-critical functions.
Splendid idea! Double down on it.
